messages:
alex: quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — thanks for the thorough writeup. main takeaway: paging spike came from cache-miss-rate-alert flapping after the midnight deploy. we need owners, concrete fixes, and dates.

jamie: i'll own threshold tuning + alert config. plan is to switch the alert to a 5m rolling rate with a 3-sample hysteresis and add a suppression window after deploys. will open a PR by EOD. :thumbsup:

alex: perfect. please include current vs proposed firing rate in the PR (count of fires/day).

sasha: i'll take dedupe & suppression rules. propose: if the alert is tagged with `deploy=true` or `release=<build>` then suppress for 15m, and add dedupe key on host-pool+region. will test in staging. PR target: Tue.

matt: i'll own the remediation item to harden cache (reduce N+1 on warm path). ETA for a small fix is 2 weeks, larger rollout 6 weeks. i'll add a smoke test to the post-deploy job to catch regressions.

ops-lead: we need a verification plan. owners: jamie for alerts, sasha for dedupe, matt for code. please add explicit acceptance criteria so we can close action items in the postmortem. suggest: 7-day rolling reduction >= 70% in pages and no regression in real error rate.

jamie: acceptance criteria noted. i'll add a dashboard for before/after and a synthetic that triggers at the old threshold so we can compare. linking to the perf dashboard when done.

oncall-bot: incident 2837654321 marked resolved by alex — duration 2h14m — runbook link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2837654321 (auto-note)

sasha: quick snippet i'll include in the suppression PR:
```yaml
alert: cache-miss-rate-alert
condition: rolling_avg(5m) > 0.12
suppression:
  when_tag: deploy=true
  window: 15m
dedupe_key: "host_pool:region"
```

alex: thanks — also add a note in the runbook to explicitly call the runbook owner when suppression is active (so we don't mask a real outage).

matt: on the fix: i'll push an incremented cache TTL and add a guard for the N+1 path. rolling release plan: canary -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days.

ops-lead: timeline check: jamie PR by today, sasha PR by Tue, matt canary by 2 weeks. let's set a checkpoint next Thursday 11am to review metrics. /schedule weekly-checkpoint next_thursday 11:00 @ops-team

jamie: booked the dashboard and will have the PR up in ~4hrs. :eyes:

sasha: putting a draft suppression rule up now — will tag it WIP so we can iterate.

matt: created the branch and smoke test — will open PR for code changes next week.

alex: cool. owners — please update the postmortem action-item list with links to your PR and target dates. i'll close items once acceptance criteria are met. thanks all. :raised_hands:
